name: UBITS
all_locations: Mexico City, CDMX, Mexico; Santiago, Santiago Metropolitan Region, Chile; Lima, Callao Region, Peru; Panama City, Panama, Panama; Remote
long_description: We help Spanish-speaking companies create, execute and measure their online learning strategy. We offer more than 5.000 courses across three categories: Soft skills, business, and tech skills.
one_liner: Learning Hub for companies in Latam

app_answers.question: What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer:
Ubits is a corporate e-learning company that disrupts learning by focusing on the learner and the technology first.

We propose a feature-based machine learning approach to personalized recommendations, that is capable of creating concise learning paths (training playlist) and adaptive evaluations for each student depending on their behavior, learning preferences (videos, podcasts, articles,readings), career level and position inside the company by using our own high quality content. 

Our value proposition to companies: we train employees in a super-fast way, with better retention, higher acquiring specific needs, at the time that requires it, according to their career goals and their needs inside the company at a competitive cost. 

Our value proposition to students: short personalized training content based on what they want and what they need, with top industry experts teaching them, with a learning experience that maximize the span of attention, that they can use anytime to improve their abilities while connecting to people from other companies and learning from them.

news.title: UBITS snags $25M to create ‘the Netflix for corporate training’ in LatAm – TechCrunch
